name: art.storeshot/storeshot
title: Storeshot
description: App Store and Google Play screenshots from your coding agent: store rules, sets, fastlane.

environmentVariables.name: STORESHOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Use this key (never stored); its prefix decides the environment

environmentVariables.name: STORESHOT_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: test or live: the environment of a linked key

environmentVariables.name: STORESHOT_MCP_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: An absolute folder: every local read and write must be inside it

environmentVariables.name: STORESHOT_MCP_NO_STORE
environmentVariables.description: 1: never read or write the credentials file
